findings.problem: With Telugu switched on, most of what a teacher must act on is still English. Home 'మీ దృష్టి అవసరం' card: all 4 items are English ('1 paper of yours past the marks due date', '72 pieces of homework to check', 'Early warnings: 2 students need a closer look'). Also 'No school today', 'Sunday is not a working day', 'My class: Class 5 A', 'Students · Room 112', 'Roll 1 · photo missing', 'Homework of the last 7 days · 0% overall'. Admin home: 'New enquiries', 'In the last 7 days', 'See papers' (the buttons next to it are Telugu), and every attention item. A Telugu-first clerk can read the headings but not the actual tasks.
findings.fix: Put the dashboard attention-item sentences and stat-card subtitles through t() with Telugu entries. Add a CI check that fails when a te.ts key is missing for any string shown on the home screens.

findings.problem: The main action buttons and the results after saving are hard-coded English. In 'హోంవర్క్ ఇవ్వండి' the only button that sends is 'Send to 5 A', and its pending text is 'Sending…'. Built as `Send to ${...}` in sheets.tsx:97 without t(). Other sheets have 'Send to N parents' and 'Resend to N parents?'. The enquiry form says 'Source *', 'Changing it later needs a reason.' and 'More details'. After saving, the toast reads 'Enquiry added for L3 సాయి కిరణ్.'
findings.fix: Wrap these template strings in t() with placeholders (e.g. t('Send to {class}')) and add the Telugu entries: '{class}కు పంపండి', 'పంపుతోంది…', '{name} విచారణ జోడించబడింది'.

findings.problem: Under the student name the counter reads '4 లో 16 · SPS/2023/0210' for '4 of 16'. In Telugu that means '16 out of 4'. The sentence is built word by word ('of' → 'లో'), so the numbers come out in the wrong order. 'నమోదు చేశారు 3 of 16' on the same screen stays English.
findings.fix: Use one whole-sentence key such as '{i} of {n}' → '{n} లో {i}', never a lone 'of' key. Search for other places that use t('of').

findings.problem: After tapping 'తర్వాతి' the screen says 'తర్వాతి కీ నొక్కితే ఈ మార్కు మారిపోతుంది.' The big blue Next button is also called 'తర్వాతి', so a teacher reads it as 'pressing Next will change this mark' and is afraid to move on. The English meaning is 'the next key you type replaces this mark'.
findings.fix: Telugu: 'ఇప్పుడు టైప్ చేసే అంకె ఈ మార్కును మారుస్తుంది.'

findings.problem: After tapping 'Send to 5 A' the homework was already saved: the list behind the sheet showed 'L3 అభ్యాసం 4.3 ప్రశ్నలు 1-5'. But the sheet stayed open for about 2–4 s with the filled form and the button back on 'Send to 5 A', not 'Sending…'. It closed on a later run after a 6 s wait. A teacher who taps again would send the homework, and the parent messages, twice.
findings.fix: Keep the button disabled with 'పంపుతోంది…' until the sheet closes, or close the sheet as soon as state.ok arrives. Show a 'హోంవర్క్ పంపబడింది' toast.

findings.problem: Day and month names stay English inside Telugu sentences, even though the page header shows 'ఆదివారం, 15 నవంబర్'. Examples: 'హాజరు మళ్లీ Monday 16 November న తెరుచుకుంటుంది', 'Sunday · No school', 'ఇచ్చిన తేదీ Sun 15 Nov · గడువు Mon 16 Nov', 'Was due 2 Nov', 'Tomorrow', 'Thu', 'Sun 22'.
findings.fix: Send every short and long date and weekday through the locale date formatter (formatDate with lang), and translate 'Tomorrow'/'Today' (రేపు/ఈరోజు).

findings.problem: A Telugu clerk types the name in Telugu ('పూజ') and gets 'సరిపోయే విద్యార్థులు లేరు' / 'ఈ పేరుతో ఎవరూ లేరు: “పూజ” లో any class.' Names are stored in English letters, and nothing tells the clerk to type them in English. The message also mixes in English ('any class') and has broken word order.
findings.fix: When the search text is in Telugu script, say 'పేర్లు ఇంగ్లీష్ అక్షరాలలో ఉన్నాయి — Pooja లా టైప్ చేయండి' (or transliterate before searching). Translate 'any class' → 'ఏ తరగతిలోనూ'.

findings.problem: Whole tab rows stay English in Telugu mode. Exams: 'Datesheet | Marks Entry | Results | Report Cards', plus the breadcrumb 'Marks Entry / Half Yearly…'. Student profile: 'Overview | Academics | Time Table | Attendance | Fees | Exams | Homework | …', the stat cards 'Attendance', 'Fees due', 'Documents 0 of 6', and every 'Edit'. The tabs are the main way to move around, so the clerk is lost here.
findings.fix: Translate the module tab labels and student-profile tabs and stat titles (most words already exist in te.ts, e.g. 'హాజరు', 'ఫీజులు', 'పరీక్షలు').

findings.problem: The page title is 'Students' in English, while every other page title and the side menu are Telugu. In the class chips only one class is translated: 'తరగతి 5' sits between 'Class 4' and 'Class 6'. 'Fees: everyone', 'More filters', 'Show removed', '₹13,000 overdue' and the search placeholder are English.
findings.fix: Translate the 'Students' page title. Translate class names in one consistent way: all 'తరగతి N' or all left as data, never only one. Translate the filter words and 'overdue' (బాకీ).

findings.problem: The attach button for a web link is labelled 'కలపండి', which means 'mix/combine'. A teacher will not guess that it adds a link. The te.ts entry 'Link' → 'కలపండి' is shared with the 'link a parent' meaning.
findings.fix: Use a separate key for the attachment, e.g. 'Add link' → 'లింక్ జోడించండి'. Keep 'కలపండి' only for linking records.

findings.problem: The attendance screens a teacher uses every day are half English. 'Attendance for 13-11-2026 locked at 11:00 AM.', the count tiles 'Present / Absent / Late / Leave / Not marked', and the 'Name or roll no.' search are English. On the correction page: 'తిరిగి register', 'Class and section', 'Date', 'Student(s)', 'Find by name', 'ఇప్పుడు: Not marked', and the whole 'సవరణలు ఎలా పనిచేస్తాయి' steps ('Attendance locks at 11:00 AM each day', 'You ask for the change with a reason'…). The page subtitle 'The principal approves it. Old marks are kept.' is English too.
findings.fix: Translate these attendance strings (హాజరు/గైర్హాజరు/ఆలస్యం/సెలవు/వేయలేదు). Consider Telugu tooltips for P/A/L, or హా/గై/ఆ letters.

findings.problem: The date range filter reads '15-11-2026 నుండి 15-11-2026'. 'నుండి' means 'from', so the word between the dates says the opposite of 'to', and no 'వరకు' follows.
findings.fix: Translate the range as '{from} నుండి {to} వరకు', or put 'వరకు' after the second date.

findings.problem: The Medical Leave tile reads 'వైద్యం (ML)' ('medical treatment'). The grid legend on the same page correctly says 'వైద్య సెలవు'. The two words disagree and the tile reads oddly.
findings.fix: 'Medical (ML)' → 'వైద్య సెలవు (ML)'.

findings.problem: Broken Telugu word order. The profile button says 'సందేశం తల్లిదండ్రులు' ('message parents' word for word), while home says 'తల్లిదండ్రులకు మెసేజ్'. The emergency-contact buttons read 'జరపండి Mahesh Menon కిందకి' and 'జరపండి Vani Menon పైకి', with the verb first.
findings.fix: 'తల్లిదండ్రులకు సందేశం' (the same as home). Use one whole-sentence key: '{name}ను కిందకు జరపండి' / '{name}ను పైకి జరపండి'.

findings.problem: Homework cards say 'చూసినవారు 0 లో 15', which reads as 'seen 0 in 15'. The summary cards stay English: 'Current · this month', '61 pieces of work for 2 classes', 'Waiting for you to check', 'From WhatsApp read receipts', 'Current · 4 | History · 0', 'Search homework title', 'All classes'.
findings.fix: '15 లో 0 మంది చూశారు'. Translate the summary cards, the filters and the Current/History pills (ప్రస్తుతం / పాతవి).

findings.problem: The notice form calls the recipients 'ప్రేక్షకులు' ('audience/spectators'), which is odd for parents. 'Normal / High / Critical', every channel name ('Notice board (always)', 'App notification', 'Parent Link (always for parents)'), 'Nothing ticked: the whole school.', the subtitle 'Notices to parents go for approval first.' and the browser's 'Choose Files / No file chosen' are English. After sending, the detail page shows 'By', 'Parents of Class 5', 'Not yet' and '30 days after publishing'.
findings.fix: 'ఎవరికి' instead of 'ప్రేక్షకులు'. Translate priority, channel, helper and detail words. Replace the native file input with a Telugu 'ఫైళ్ళు ఎంచుకోండి' button.

findings.problem: In the enquiry form the Source chips are Telugu ('నేరుగా వచ్చారు', 'ఫోన్'), but the table's 'మూలం' column shows the same values in English ('Walk-in', 'Phone', 'Website'). The table also has 'Not decided', 'Tomorrow, 11:00 AM', '24 open enquiries', 'Any date added', 'All sources', 'Export', placeholders 'First and last name' / 'Father, mother or guardian', and paging '47లో 1 నుండి 25' (no 'వరకు'). The year select is cut off: '2027-28 (Main Camp'.
findings.fix: Show the source and status values through the same labels as the form. Translate the filters, placeholders and paging ('47 లో 1 నుండి 25 వరకు'). Shorten the year option or widen the select.

findings.problem: On the Send message page these are English: 'Sections / One person', 'Parents / Students', 'Your sections', 'General', 'None, type my own message', '0 of 1,000 characters · Blanks you can use…', '– parents', 'Choose at least one section.', 'పరిమితి Your own sections', and the warning 'A message cannot be unsent once delivered.' 'ఉచితం' and 'Free' appear one above the other. The email 'office@sunriseschool.ed u.in' breaks mid-word, and the title placeholder is cut off: 'Shown at the top of an email or app noti'.
findings.fix: Translate these strings. Use one word for free ('ఉచితం'). Break the email at the '@' or truncate it with a tooltip. Shorten the placeholder.

findings.problem: The only way to the language setting is the English line 'My profile, password and language' in the avatar menu. On the profile page the Language block sits below the long 'My details' list, about one screen down on a phone. A Telugu-first person who reads little English will not find it. Once there, choosing 'తెలుగు' works at once, which is good.
findings.fix: Add a globe icon row in the avatar menu that shows the current language in its own script ('భాష / Language: English'). On the profile page, move Language to the top or link it from the header.

findings.problem: The profile page itself (in Telugu) still has 'Last changed 31-10-2026', 'A code to your phone or email after your password. Safer if someone learns your password.', 'Active now', 'Last used …', 'Chrome on Windows' and the role 'Class Teacher' (the badge next to it is translated as 'క్లాస్ టీచర్').
findings.fix: Translate these security and device strings and the role name in the subtitle.

findings.problem: On a 390 px phone the Telugu words are longer, so tabs cut off mid-word at the right edge ('విద్యార్థి సెలవు', 'అధ్యయన సామ…', 'WhatsApp ఇన్‌బా…') with only a small arrow. The top bar title truncates to 'సవరణ అభ్యర్థిం…' and 'హోంవర్క్ & అభ్యా…'.
findings.fix: Fade the tab row's edge, scroll the active tab into view, and use shorter Telugu tab names. Let the top-bar title wrap to two lines or use a short form.

tasksDone:
I worked as a Telugu-first user for about 40 minutes.

**Switching to Telugu:** I found the setting through the avatar menu, under the English line 'My profile, password and language', then the Language block on the profile page. Choosing 'తెలుగు' worked at once.

**Teacher, on a 390 px phone, in Telugu:**
- **Home:** read the whole home screen.
- **Attendance:** Today is Sunday, so the app correctly showed no school. Friday's register is locked, so I opened the correction request form but did not submit it.
- **Homework:** gave 2 homework to Class 5 A, titled in Telugu: 'L3 అభ్యాసం 4.3 ప్రశ్నలు 1-5' and 'L3 పాఠం 2 చదవండి'.
- **Marks:** on the Half Yearly Maths 6 A paper I entered Bhavya Naidu's Theory mark as 62, used the one-at-a-time view and the grid, and did not submit the paper.
- **Other screens:** opened the More menu, the Message parents page and the homework page in dark mode.

**Admin, on a 1440 px computer, in Telugu:**
- **Dashboard:** read the home screen.
- **Find a student:** searched in Telugu script ('పూజ', no result) and in English ('Pooja', found), and opened Pooja Menon's profile.
- **Notice:** sent the notice 'L3 సోమవారం తల్లిదండ్రుల సమావేశం' to Class 5 parents. It is waiting for the principal's approval.
- **Enquiry:** added enquiry ENQ-0048 for child 'L3 సాయి కిరణ్', parent 'L3 రమేష్', phone 9000000731, source Phone.

**Back to normal:** both teacher and admin are set back to 'The school's language', so they see English again, as they did before.

**Files:** screenshots are in D:/all/Projects/School-OS/qa-output/loop/ (all start with 'l3-telugu-'). My steps files and the small enquiry script are in D:/all/Projects/School-OS/qa-output/loop3/. I did not change any repo file.

findings.problem: Tapping 'फ़ॉर्म पढ़ें (संस्करण 1)' on 'Use of my child's data' shows the legal text with a raw placeholder: 'I agree that {school} may keep and use my child's details…'. Settings > Data security > Consent promises '{school} is replaced with the school's name.', but no code replaces it (grep finds no replace of {school} anywhere in src).
findings.fix: Replace {school} with the school name wherever consent text is shown or stored (Parent Link, admission form, PDF), and add a test that no '{' placeholder reaches a parent screen.

findings.problem: The page is in Hindi, but the consent forms the parent is asked to agree to are English only: title 'Use of my child's data' / 'Photos of my child' and the whole legal paragraph. A parent with little English is asked to give legal consent with a one-time code to text they cannot read. consent_text has only an 'en' version.
findings.fix: Ship Hindi and Telugu versions of the two built-in consent texts, and show the parent's language. If a school's custom text has no version in that language, add the line 'यह फ़ॉर्म सिर्फ़ अंग्रेज़ी में है, सवाल हो तो स्कूल को फ़ोन करें'.

findings.problem: After booking a PTM time on the Hindi page, the green result line is English: 'Booked: 10:00 AM with Ravi Teja. A confirmation message is on its way.' Cancelling shows 'Cancelled your meeting with Ravi Teja at 10:00 AM on Wed 25-11-2026. You can book again until the day before.' The same applies to 'Changed. Your meeting…', 'You already have…', and event 'Thank you. Your consent for … is recorded.' / 'Saved. Your child is not going to…'. These are template strings in src/app/p/[token]/ptm-actions.ts lines 52-70 and event-actions.ts lines 82-96, so they never match the catalogue.
findings.fix: Use t() with placeholders, e.g. t('Booked: {time} with {teacher}. …', {time, teacher}), as the consent success message already does.

findings.problem: The parent page HTML is 2.1 MB (478 KB gzipped), even for the first 'पक्का करें कि यह आप हैं' code screen. The inline payload carries the whole staff word catalogue ('Attendance Management', 'Attendance for a class in under a minute', 94 'Attendance' strings and more). On a cheap Android phone on mobile data that is several seconds of blank screen before anything shows. Measured: 544 KB transferred, 18 requests.
findings.fix: Pass the Parent Link page only the words it uses (a small parent catalogue for the guardian's language), not the full app dictionary.

findings.problem: The parent's job 'see homework' and 'reply/message the teacher' dead-ends. The page has no homework at all, though the office sees 'Homework done 70% · 3 missing' for Kabir. It has no way to message or even see the class teacher; the only contact is 'कोई सवाल? स्कूल कार्यालय को फ़ोन करें 04023456789'. The class teacher's name (Ravi Teja) appears only inside the PTM card. This matches the blueprint ('Parent Link does not show homework yet'), but to a parent it is a missing piece.
findings.fix: For now, add one card: 'Class teacher: Ravi Teja' with a WhatsApp/Call-school button, plus a line 'Homework comes on WhatsApp'. Next, a small homework list (this week, done or missing).

findings.problem: November shows a big green '100% उपस्थित' while the line under it says '11 स्कूल दिवसों में से 1 दर्ज' (only 1 of 11 days marked). The 10 unmarked days are dashed empty boxes that the legend does not explain (P/A/L/LV/H only). A parent cannot tell whether those days were absences. There is also no whole-year figure: the office sees 94.5%, the parent only sees month by month.
findings.fix: Show the % only when most days are marked, otherwise 'अभी 1 दिन दर्ज'. Add a legend item for the dashed box ('दर्ज नहीं'), and a small 'इस साल: 94.5%' line.

findings.problem: Leave and Holiday become almost the same word. Hindi: 'LV छुट्टी' vs 'H अवकाश दिवस' (छुट्टी is the everyday word for a school holiday). Telugu: 'LV సెలవు' vs 'H సెలవు దినం'. A parent reads both as holiday and cannot tell 'my child took leave' from 'school closed'. The legend letters P/A/L/LV/H are also English.
findings.fix: Use clearly different words, e.g. Hindi 'ली गई छुट्टी (अर्ज़ी)' vs 'स्कूल बंद'; Telugu 'సెలవు తీసుకున్నారు' vs 'స్కూల్ సెలవు'. 'School closed' is already used in the events list.

findings.problem: A parent who lost the WhatsApp link opens the school address, lands on the staff sign-in page in Hindi, types their mobile under 'वन-टाइम कोड से साइन इन करें' and gets a broken mixed sentence: 'हमने the mobile number or email on that login, if it is on School OS पर 6 अंकों का कोड भेजा है।' No code ever comes, and nothing says parents don't sign in here.
findings.fix: Translate the whole sentence (no English chunk inside a Hindi line). Add one line on the sign-in page: 'माता-पिता: स्कूल के WhatsApp/SMS संदेश वाला लिंक खोलें।'

findings.problem: Every fee line is English on the Hindi/Telugu page: 'Tuition fee, Quarter 1 (Apr to Jun)', 'Annual charges, Year 2026-27', 'Exam fee, Half 2 (Oct to Mar)'. A little-English parent cannot tell what each amount is for.
findings.fix: Build the period part from translated words ('तिमाही 1 (अप्रैल–जून)') and let the school add a local-language name for each fee head; fall back to English only for custom names.

findings.problem: The card is titled 'बकाया फ़ीस' / 'Fees due', but its 'शेष राशि ₹32,500' includes a ₹8,000 line marked 'अभी देय नहीं' (Not due). The office's student page says 'Fees due ₹24,500 · ₹24,500 overdue', so parent and school quote different numbers on the phone. 'Tuition fee, Quarter 1 ₹500' also gives no hint that it is the rest of a part-paid ₹8,000.
findings.fix: Show two numbers: 'अभी देना है ₹24,500' (big, red) and 'बाद में ₹8,000' (small). On part-paid lines add '₹7,500 दिए, ₹500 बाकी'.

findings.problem: Marks and progress are only three 'PDF डाउनलोड करें' buttons (Unit Test 1, Unit Test 2, Term 1). To see how the child did, the parent must download and open a PDF on a cheap phone. The office sees 'Unit Test 2 75.2% · B1' at a glance.
findings.fix: Show one line per published exam on the page ('Unit Test 2: 75% · B1', with subjects on tap) and keep the PDF as a secondary link.

findings.problem: After typing the code, the green box says 'धन्यवाद। “Use of my child's data” के लिए आपकी सहमति दर्ज हो गई।', but the row right above it still says 'Kabir Sharma · नहीं दी' (not given). The parent must tap 'पेज फिर से दिखाएँ' to see 'दी'. This is a contradiction on the same screen. Each form also needs its own SMS code (2 forms = 2 codes).
findings.fix: Refresh the row in place after success (✓ '15-11-2026 को दी') and drop the 'show page again' link. Offer 'दोनों के लिए हाँ' with one code when several forms are pending.

findings.problem: 'वापस लें' (withdraw consent) sits on the same card where the next step's button is 'वापस' (back). The two words differ by one syllable. A parent who wants to go back can easily withdraw consent, and one who wants to withdraw may tap 'वापस'. Nothing explains what withdrawing changes.
findings.fix: Rename withdraw to 'सहमति हटाएँ' and back to 'रद्द करें'/'नहीं', and add one line on what stops (e.g. photos of your child will not be shown).

findings.problem: Everything is one 3,860 px scroll on a 390 px phone: 7 fee lines first, then receipts, attendance, report cards, notices, events, consent. A parent who only wants 'was my child present today' or the receipt has to scroll several screens, and nothing at the top says what is below.
findings.fix: Add a sticky row of 4-5 icon chips at the top (फ़ीस, उपस्थिति, अंक, सूचनाएँ, PTM) that jump to each card, and collapse the fee lines to the overdue total with 'सब देखें'.

findings.problem: Notices are English only ('Diwali holidays – The school is closed from 30 October…'). In English mode the priority tag reads 'High', which is jargon (Hindi correctly says 'ज़रूरी'). The ▾ toggle adds nothing for short notices: the full text already shows when closed.
findings.fix: Offer translated notices (the blueprint's translate-on-send) or at least the title in the parent's language. Use 'Important' in English. Hide the chevron when the text is already fully shown.

findings.problem: Weekday names stay English inside Hindi text: 'अभिभावक–शिक्षक बैठक · Wed 25-11-2026', 'आप Tue 24-11-2026 तक समय बदल…', album 'Thu 01-10-2026'. The events list just below uses 'बुधवार'. 'Class teacher, 5 A' and 'Class 5 A' under the child's name are English too.
findings.fix: Use the same localised date helper the events list uses, and translate 'Class teacher' / 'Class'.

findings.problem: Tapping 'फ़ोटो: Science exhibition 2026' opens an album page with no way back to the Parent Link (no back button or link). Each photo opens a raw /api/v1/files/... file with no label. The note 'सिर्फ़ उन विद्यार्थियों की फ़ोटो दिखती हैं जिनके अभिभावकों ने फ़ोटो सहमति दी है' does not tell this parent (who has not given photo consent) that their own child is hidden because of it.
findings.fix: Add '← पेरेंट लिंक' at the top, open photos in a simple viewer with Download, and when this parent has not consented say 'आपके बच्चे की फ़ोटो नहीं दिख रहीं: फ़ोटो सहमति दें'.

findings.problem: I registered Hari (9000000742). Then I pressed Back, saw a blank form, thought it had not saved, and typed the same phone again. The form only said "Returning visitor. findings.problem: I typed visitor Kumar (9000000745), the visitor left, so I pressed "Cancel". When the next visitor arrived, "Add visitor" opened already filled with Kumar's phone and name. The only hint was a small grey line: "Draft kept: what you typed last time". At a busy desk I would type over the name and keep the wrong phone. The expense form does the same: after Cancel it still holds the ₹700.

findings.problem: After "Register and make pass" the pass sheet opened. When I pressed the phone's Back button, an empty "New visitor" form came up (the address goes back to ?do=visitor). findings.problem: With Cheque chosen, the boxes show "004512" and "SBI, Kukatpally" in grey. They look filled, so I clicked Collect. The error then said "Cheque number has 6 digits" under a box that shows 6 digits. That makes no sense to a layman. The visitor and enquiry phone boxes have the same problem: "+91 98480 12345" looks like a number someone already typed.
findings.fix: Use plain hint text such as "6-digit number on the cheque" and "Bank and branch", and change the error to "Type the cheque number (6 digits)" or "Type the bank name".

findings.problem: I typed the same UTR 900000123456 that I had used a minute earlier. The red text under the amount said "₹5,000 upi for Sneha Nair was collected at 8:35 AM by you. A UTR that was already used should never be accepted twice, but one more click would save it. The message also says "upi" in small letters and never mentions that the UTR is the same.

findings.problem: New problem, phone 390 px, Principal opening "Transport fuel ₹10,080". The Approve / Ask for a change / Reject bar should stay pinned above the bottom menu, but it is missing from the first screen. It only shows after scrolling to the end of the page. The cause: <main> has the class animate-rise, which leaves transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) on it, so the bar's position: fixed is measured against main and not the screen. Any other position: fixed bar inside a page has the same problem.
findings.fix: Animate only opacity, or remove the transform when the animation ends (no fill-mode both). The other option is to render the decision bar through a portal on <body>.
